title: Fix admin access and surface admin panel for content management

requirements.text: Fix the admin role check so the frontend correctly detects when the signed-in user is an admin, and ensure the Admin navigation link and /admin routes become accessible for admins.

quotes: i am the admin but i can not see any admin plus points like adding a breed adding related video links (youtube) adding new pet categories etc in this web please add admin panel where i can do all these

acceptanceCriteria: When signed in as an admin principal, the navbar shows an “Admin” link that navigates to /admin.
When signed in as a non-admin principal, the “Admin” link is not shown and visiting /admin shows an access denied screen.
The frontend admin role hook calls an existing backend method that actually exists (e.g., the frontend must not call a non-existent method name).
The backend exposes a query method that returns whether the caller is an admin (currently backend/main.mo exposes `isAdmin()`), and the frontend uses that method consistently.

requirements.text: Ensure the Admin panel provides working sections to add/edit/delete Pet Categories, Breeds, and related YouTube video links, gated behind admin-only access.

quotes: please add admin panel where i can do all these

acceptanceCriteria: Admin Dashboard (/admin) displays navigation cards for managing Pet Categories, Breeds, and Video Links.
Admins can open the Pet Categories admin page and create/update/delete categories (including optional image upload where supported by existing UI).
Admins can open the Breeds admin page and create/update/delete breeds (including optional image upload where supported by existing UI).
Admins can open the Video Links admin page and create/update/delete YouTube video links (using the existing admin video management flow).

constraints: Backend must remain a single Motoko actor in backend/main.mo; do not introduce additional backend services.
Do not edit files under frontend/src/components/ui (read-only UI primitives).
Do not edit frontend immutable hook files listed in system constraints; implement changes in editable hooks/components/pages instead.
All user-facing text must be in English.
nonGoals: Adding third-party authentication providers (only Internet Identity is supported).
Adding external databases or non-IC storage backends.
Implementing real-time collaboration or chat in the admin panel.
